name: Gun Control
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of conflict and the necessity of defense, as seen when Moses commands the people to arm themselves for battle (Numbers 31:3) and Nehemiah describes workers holding weapons while rebuilding the wall (Nehemiah 4:17). God's justice demands accountability for life, emphasizing the value of human life and the consequences of harm (Genesis 9:5; Exodus 21:24). David's psalm also highlights that God equips His people with strength and skill for fighting when necessary (Psalms 144:1). These passages collectively affirm the biblical recognition of self-defense and the responsibility to uphold justice.
